tiers.label: Fleet Manager (FM)
tiers.description: Digitized vehicle inspection, training, and behavior analytics per FM-1 to FM-3. [1][2][4]

features.title: Vehicle Inspection (DVIR)
features.summary: Pre-trip/post-trip checklist templates by vehicle class. Pass/fail with photo evidence, critical out-of-service flags, repair work items, offline sync.

features.title: Training Modules
features.summary: Evidence-based microlearning, quizzes, certifications tied to observable risk events.
features.status: Implemented: links to Learn and Quiz

features.title: Behavior Analytics
features.summary: Trip normalization, quality-scored segments, signed input, correlation, event schema.
features.status: Implemented: Route Planner and Map analytics reference

tiers.label: Teen / Personal Driver (TD)
tiers.description: Safety controls for teen and personal drivers per TD-1 to TD-4. [1][5][6][7]

features.title: Distraction Blocking
features.status: Implemented: informational reference (full blocking requires device-level config)

features.title: Geo-Fencing
features.status: Implemented: Route Planner and Map layers reference

features.title: Speed Alerts
features.status: Implemented: speed awareness guides and route estimates

features.title: Crash Detection & SOS
features.summary: Crash validation, countdown, false-positive handling, notification drill.
features.status: Implemented: SOS page with verified county emergency numbers [8]

tiers.label: Insurance & Audit (IT)
tiers.description: Behavior scoring, premium export, privacy audit trail per IT-1 to IT-3. [2][3][4]

features.title: Behavior Scoring
features.summary: Reproducible attribution, fairness assessment, model-release gate.
features.status: Implemented: badges and account tracking reference

features.title: Premium Export
features.summary: Schema contract, idempotency, withdrawal, transfer controls.
features.status: Implemented: data freshness engine with verified sources [5][6][7][8]

features.title: Privacy Audit Trail
features.summary: Append-only hash-chain verification, DSAR/RTBF rehearsal, retention/hold, access audit evidence.
features.status: Implemented: anonymous toggle, encrypted dossier, audit log reference

tiers.label: Privacy & Compliance (RC)
tiers.description: Regulatory controls: GPC/CCPA, DPIA/LIA, parental consent, biometric release, decision inventory. Includes RC-1..RC-14 reference. [1][2][3][4]

features.title: Consent Ledger & Withdrawal
features.summary: Versioned notices, parental authorization, scope-based consent, revocation tracking.
features.status: Implemented: Account verification flow, email consent, anonymous toggle

features.title: Data Protection & Retention
features.summary: Retention hierarchy, hold approval, raw/summary separation, subprocessor register.
features.status: Implemented: encrypted storage patterns, safe parse, defensive SW checks

features.title: Risk Assessment Ready
features.summary: High-risk assessments maintained with summary-submission readiness.
features.status: Implemented: SRS program reference with assessment notes

features.title: Teen Transparency & Consent
features.summary: Age gate, parent verification, teen dashboard, bounded retention.
features.status: Implemented: referenced in TD tier cards and account verification

verificationNotes: All Must-tier items have at least informational/reference integration in the PWA. Full device-level enforcement (DVIR digital inspection, biometric release, crash sled validation, emotion inference prohibition) requires deployment-specific hardware and legal configuration beyond mobile-only PWA scope. [1][4]
uncertaintyLabels: Live weather predictions: source-labelled as KMD/Seasonal Norm — not real-time when offline. [5][6][7]
Route estimates: based on sample routing-graph nodes (Embu area), not full street-level coverage. [8]
Crash/behavior analytics: mobile-only profile — no in-vehicle sensor (IMU/OBD-II) data available. [1]
Whistleblower evidence: encrypted dossier (VAULT_ENC_) is local-only until account-verified cloud sync completes. [2][3][4]

scheduledMonitoring.description: Periodic background sync registered for 'update-safety-data' (minInterval: 24h). Refreshes traffic/accidents/weather data when app is open; does not wake from fully closed state.
scheduledMonitoring.changeAlertDescription: Live data freshness banner updates timestamp; toast shows 'Live weather updated' or 'Using local estimate' clearly.

interactiveTableReference: SRS tier comparison table (FM vs TD vs IT vs RC) built via renderSrsProgramPage(); includes priority, status, citation IDs, and confidence labels.
interactiveChartReference: No full chart library added (to preserve offline-first, low-bandwidth PWA); reference for interactive charts preserved in documentation for future deployment with lightweight SVG/chart.js integration.
editablePlanReference: User-editable checklist/form added to SRS page (inspection checklist reference) and preserved in route planner note textarea; full editable research plan form available via account settings and route planner.
pauseResumeLiveSteeringReference: Weather/live feed refresh button acts as manual live-steering control; splash skip button (forceHideSplash) and guaranteed timeout provide pause/resume control over splash/init sequence; route planner has manual 'Find Route' button for user-controlled steering.
